title: LLM-Safety Evaluations Lack Robustness
reasoning: The paper is a position paper that critiques the methodology and robustness of current LLM safety benchmarks. While it mentions that definitions of 'harmfulness' are rooted in ethical and societal norms, its core focus is on the technical and statistical reliability of evaluation pipelines (dataset curation, jailbreaking attacks, LLM judges) rather than evaluating religion, morals, or ethics themselves.
